# Float Like A Lotus

> Float Like A Lotus is a therapeutic wellness, hypnotherapy, and life coaching practice founded by Shilpa Reddy in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Specializing in certified Rapid Transformational Therapy (RTT®) under Marisa Peer, clinical hypnotherapy, life coaching, and energy healing, Float Like A Lotus guides individuals, high performers, children, and organizations to rise above emotional mud, anxiety, and trauma to bloom into their highest potential.

## Practitioner & Practice Details
- **Founder & Lead Therapist:** Shilpa Reddy
- **Training & Credentials:** Certified Rapid Transformational Therapy (RTT®) Practitioner, trained directly in the UK by globally acclaimed therapist Marisa Peer (creator of RTT®). Also integrates energy healing and 8+ years of environmental/interior space psychology.
- **Physical Address:** Flat 502, 5th Floor, Plot No. 61, Snehitha Hills, PBEL City Road, near TGPA academy, Hyderabad, Telangana – 500086, India.
- **Coordinates:** 17.3457° N, 78.3619° E
- **Contact Number / WhatsApp:** [+91 8498057950](https://wa.me/+918498057950)
- **Email:** shilpa@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Friday: 08:00 – 18:30 IST
- **Session Formats:** Confidential in-person sessions in Hyderabad & secure virtual / online sessions worldwide.
- **Official Website:** [https://floatlikealotus.com/](https://floatlikealotus.com/)

## Core Services

### Hypnotherapy & Subconscious Reprogramming
- [Hypnotherapy for Anxiety](https://floatlikealotus.com/anxiety.html): Rapid relief from chronic worry, generalized anxiety, and panic attacks by uncovering root emotional triggers and calming the autonomic nervous system.
- [Hypnotherapy for Depression](https://floatlikealotus.com/depression.html): Gentle subconscious therapy to lift emotional heaviness, heal past wounds, and reconnect with inner joy, passion, and purpose.
- [Hypnotherapy for Addictions](https://floatlikealotus.com/addictions.html): Breaking addictive habits, dependencies, and cravings through deep subconscious rewiring and emotional resilience.
- [Abundance Mindset](https://floatlikealotus.com/abundance-mindset.html): Overcoming subconscious scarcity programming and financial blocks to cultivate prosperity and receptivity.
- [Self-Esteem & Inner Worth](https://floatlikealotus.com/self-esteem.html): Rebuilding foundational confidence, releasing imposter syndrome, and silencing harsh internal criticism.
- [Weight Issues & Mindful Eating](https://floatlikealotus.com/weight-issues.html): Healing emotional eating, eliminating guilt around food, and aligning the subconscious for sustainable, natural health.

### Life Coaching & Peak Performance
- [High Performers Coaching](https://floatlikealotus.com/high-performers.html): Mindset, focus, and burnout-prevention coaching tailored for founders, CEOs, executives, and athletes.
- [Coaching for Children & Adolescents](https://floatlikealotus.com/coaching-children.html): Specialized youth coaching to conquer exam anxiety, build emotional regulation, improve focus, and develop self-assurance.
- [Personal Life Coaching](https://floatlikealotus.com/life-coaching.html): 1-on-1 coaching for life transitions, clarity, habit mastery, and goal realization.

### Workshops & Corporate Programs
- [Workshops for Schools](https://floatlikealotus.com/schools.html): Engaging emotional wellness, mindfulness, and resilience programs for students, teachers, and school communities.
- [Workshops for Organisations](https://floatlikealotus.com/organisations.html): Workplace mental health, stress reduction, and mindful leadership workshops to prevent employee burnout.
- [Transformative Group Workshops](https://floatlikealotus.com/workshops.html): Interactive group healing sessions, subconscious workshops, and guided meditation circles.

### Specialized Wellness Topics
- [Subconscious Financial Goals](https://floatlikealotus.com/financial-goals.html): Dissolving deep-seated financial anxiety and aligning with ambitious financial objectives.
- [Holistic Energy Healing](https://floatlikealotus.com/healing.html): Releasing somatic trauma, balancing emotional energy, and holistic recovery.
- [Law of Attraction Coaching](https://floatlikealotus.com/law-of-attraction.html): Eliminating subconscious resistance to manifest harmony in health, career, and relationships.
- [Overcoming Fears & Phobias](https://floatlikealotus.com/overcoming-fears.html): Eliminating debilitating fears, social anxiety, and specific phobias in 1–3 targeted RTT sessions.
- [Self-Confidence & Assertiveness](https://floatlikealotus.com/self-confidence.html): Cultivating presence, public speaking confidence, and empowered personal boundaries.
- [Stress & Burnout Recovery](https://floatlikealotus.com/stress.html): Regulating the nervous system and achieving sustainable work-life balance.
